DELETE THIS BLOCK BEFORE SENDING. Every highlighted placeholder must be replaced. A placeholder left in a sent letter is a hard failure, so read the finished letter once with the highlighting still on, then clear it. Open on the specific thing about the company and the mandate, never on "I am applying for". One page, under 250 words, no em dashes. Swap the four proof bullets for whichever three land hardest for this role, and cut the fourth.

Commercial leaders who have scaled a business to nine figures rarely ship AI into production. The people who ship AI rarely carry a P&L. I have done both, as well as managed managers and built teams, divisions and revenue lines from scratch. With qualifications in teaching, computing, linguistics, psychology, UX and accounting, I turn abstractions and goals into business reality and design the engines that sustain them. I’m capable of holding court with a CEO or a software engineer, and I take pride in having Level 5 agency and accountability towards any situation in front of me.
